reuse.why: Extends the existing shared assertNotLinkedElsewhere that every provider link function already calls, but copies unlinkAccount's field reset instead of extracting it for both.

duplication.why: The eight-field db.updateAccount reset is a verbatim copy of the one in unlinkAccount; the flag threading through six link functions is unavoidable given the per-provider functions.

placement.why: Choosing the right shared guard keeps it in one place, but the unlink mutation now lives inside a function named and used as an assertion.

scope.why: Only the flag, its threading, the replace branch and a release note.

maintainability.why: Single decision point for all providers, but what 'unlinked' means is now defined twice and an assert with side effects is surprising.

bypasses_abstraction.where: assertNotLinkedElsewhere re-implements the local part of unlinkAccount (account_id/bank/balances/sync source/status reset) rather than sharing it.

disguised_duplication.where: The copied reset block is literal.
